description: Hook psychology and formulas for maximum retention
source_creator: LmXpbP7dD48 - content creator with nearly 1M followers, billions of views
core_concept: Curiosity Loop - make viewer watch first line, feel compelled to watch second, then third, etc.

step_1_context_lean.name: Context + Lean In
step_1_context_lean.purpose: Two things: (1) Topic clarity - what the video is about, (2) Get them leaning in
step_1_context_lean.clarity: Signal the topic immediately so viewers self-select in or out
lean_in_techniques: Reference a benefit or pain point they have
Use a metaphor to simplify complex idea
Tell them something so interesting it blows their mind
step_1_context_lean.example: The tech in the Vegas sphere is insane - biggest screen ever built, 20x bigger than IMAX

step_2_curiosity_deepen.name: Deepen the Curiosity
step_2_curiosity_deepen.purpose: Add a twist, new info, or reframe that makes them NEED to keep watching

step_3_payoff_tease.name: Payoff Tease / Transition
step_3_payoff_tease.purpose: Deliver a mini-payoff OR transition into the main content
step_3_payoff_tease.note: Don't give everything away - keep enough curiosity to continue

controversial.example: We're here because my wife got pregnant by a man

halo_effect.example: Tristan Tate's face → stops scrolling because people know him

question_hook.pattern: Ask a question that demands an answer
question_hook.example: Did you know this about X?

shock_value.pattern: Start with the most shocking moment
shock_value.example: Begin with the climax, then explain

story_hook.pattern: Start mid-story to create immediate investment

pur_mode_reference.description: Pour le mode PUR, consulter hooks_pur.json — le titre TRANSFORME le contenu au lieu de le décrire
pur_mode_reference.key_difference: hooks_psychology = descriptif (informatif, meme). hooks_pur = reframing narratif (le titre change le sens)

critical_rules.first_2_seconds: MUST have a hook - high energy, controversial, or recognizable
critical_rules.cut_frequency: Change shots every 2-3 seconds for retention
critical_rules.no_boring_parts: Cut ALL dead space, silent moments, boring transitions
critical_rules.title_card: Always add bold title card at top for context
critical_rules.caption_style: Consistent caption style across all clips (same font, colors, position)
